I have wired the durability tracker into `commit.go`, `db.go`, and `open.go`, and started running the existing test suite to verify there are no regressions.
Running the new durability test suite with the race detector enabled.
Waiting for the test tasks to finish.
Checking the repository status before committing.
I have implemented the WAL sync durability callback, wait APIs, notifications, stats, and metrics on the `batch-durable` branch:

- **EventListener & Options**:
  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/event.go#L61-L82) and [`EventListener.BatchDurable`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/event.go#L823-L826) in [event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/event.go), wired through [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/event.go#L868-L870), [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/event.go#L1060-L1062), and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/event.go#L1217-L1229).
  - Added [`WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/options.go#L41-L43) and [`WriteOptions.GetCommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/options.go#L52-L57) in [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/options.go).
- **Commit Pipeline & Batch Tracking**:
  - Updated [batch.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/batch.go), [commit.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/commit.go), [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/db.go), and [open.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/open.go) to track durability jobs, wall-clock `ApplyDuration` and `SyncDuration`, and trigger [`DB.completeBatchDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L583-L619) once per `Sync` commit (both synchronous `Apply` and `ApplyNoSyncWait` + `Batch.SyncWait`), even on WAL sync failure, while skipping non-sync commits and `DisableWAL`.
- **DB Durability APIs, Stats, & Metrics**:
  - Added [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L498-L500), [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L505-L510), [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L514-L516), [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L522-L541), [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L545-L547), [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L552-L557), [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L561-L563), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L568-L576), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go#L579-L581) in [durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability.go).
  - Exposed [`Metrics.DurableCommitCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/metrics.go#L351-L356) and [`Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/metrics.go#L351-L356) in [metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/metrics.go), accumulated only when `BatchDurable` is configured.
  - Added unit and concurrency tests in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z2f9hah4/durability_test.go).
